_readme.what: Playtest feedback — the DRAGONSLEEP playtest lamp, one verdict per checklist line.
_readme.fold_back: Whoever takes this (Cowork seat or code tab): broken and unclear lines become the fix list; too hard / too easy are tuning; notes are the tester's words, verbatim. Load this file back into the lamp to keep going.
_readme.round: TWO — seeded by the code tab 2026-09-24 from round one (playtest-ear-file-2026-09-24-grimgriz.json). Lines that passed in round one keep their verdict (notes marked R1:); lines that were broken, unclear or not tested are blank, with round one's words attached; sections 11 and 12 are new. Load this into the lamp (Load ear-file) to start round two, then Save ear-file when done.
